props.text: From cutting-edge fuel efficiency and industry-leading powertrain innovation to our first zero-emission heavy-duty electric commercial truck, the eCascadia will continue our legacy of helping customers meet their sustainability goals.
The eM2 was developed with the Freightliner eMobility team together with fleet customers and drivers, resulting in a practical electric box truck and delivery truck.

items.question: Which electric trucks are available?
items.answer: The Freightliner eCascadia is a Class 8 electric semi truck, and the Freightliner eM2 is a Class 6–7 electric box and delivery truck.

items.question: What is the typical range?
items.answer: The eCascadia has a typical range of up to 230 miles. The eM2 has a typical range of 180 or 250 miles, depending on battery capacity.

items.question: How long does it take to recharge?
items.answer: The eCascadia recharges to 80% in about 90 minutes. The eM2 recharges to 80% in about 60 minutes.

items.question: How do I get pricing or availability?
items.answer: Use the contact form on this page. A Truck Country / Stoops team member will follow up with the information you request.
